limits: QEMU 10.0.13 with machine pc-q35-8.2 is not the hosted QEMU 8.2.2 binary.
Full quota and exact causal/permission/cleanup checks are unchanged. Only exhaustion has the 12,000-tick exclusive limit and 150-second host default; a genuinely stalled fixture can fail later.
Exhaustion demonstrates allocator isolation/RPC survival, not a completed owner-B data transfer during exhaustion.
Reset containment is not automatic NIC/service restart.
Production signing policy, native/physical USB, TLS and the 50/100 goal are not accepted by these results.

The hosted compact artifact retains reports and hashes but not the raw exhaustion capture; the local raw capture was independently validated. Hosted success is not a claim of a complete downloadable raw-image archive.
